details.publicNotes:
Vitatellas are nature spirits brimming with vital energy who dwell anywhere plants can grow. They are most common in forests, jungles, and marshes, but they can also be found underwater in kelp forests and traveling between oases in deserts. Vitatellas are drawn to areas where a lack of vital energy causes plant life to suffer, particularly in places where void energy has corrupted the natural environment. Once they take root, energy slowly seeps out of them and into their surroundings, causing foliage to sprout rapidly around them.

The foliage trails they leave in their wake start off green and luscious, but after a few days without the vitatella's assistance, plants that are not well adapted to their surroundings wither away. Though vitatellas can fly and pass through the earth, they feel unnerved when they aren't in contact with the ground's surface. They seldom choose to leave the surface unless they are in dire peril.

Because vitatellas are perpetually leaking life energy, they eventually run out and return to the earth. Vitatellas, near the end of their lifespan, become increasingly incorporeal before dissipating completely. For communities that have come to rely on a vitatella for their harvests, the spirit's disappearance is a devastating outcome. A few such communities have gone to terrible lengths to gather and deliver vital energy to their local vitatella, only to discover that the vitatella responds to the infusion with violent rage. To a vitatella, this is often seen as an insult and perversion to the natural order of life, and death.

Unchecked Growth

Vitatellas cause seedlings of all kinds to quicken and sprout, making no distinction between crops and weeds. While they are a blessing to starving communities, vitatellas can be a bane to well-tended farmlands and to rich folks' ornamental flower gardens. What's more, they look unkindly on those who don't appreciate their gifts; while they won't attack a farmer for weeding their unruly bounty, they look coldly on requests that they kindly leave.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 64/140/250 gp

You step into a living tree with a trunk big enough for you to fit inside it and instantly teleport to any tree within 5 miles that also has a sufficiently large trunk. Once you enter the first tree, you instantly know the rough locations of other sufficiently large trees within range and can exit from the original tree, if you prefer. You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you; if you attempt to do so, the spell fails.

Heightened (6th) The tree you exit can be up to 50 miles away.

Heightened (8th) The tree you exit can be up to 500 miles away.

Heightened (9th) The tree you exit can be anywhere on the same planet.

You grow a wall of thorny brambles from the ground. You create a 5-foot-thick wall of brambles and thorns in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall stands vertically. If you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall has cover from creatures on the opposite side, and the wall's spaces are difficult terrain. For every move action a creature uses to enter at least one of the wall's spaces, that creature takes 3d4 piercing damage.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points. It's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section can be moved through freely.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 5, and the piercing damage increases by 1d4.

You call forth a chill wind that carries with it a barrage of fallen leaves and sharp twigs. All creatures in the area when you call the fallen leaves take 3d6 slashing damage. The winds persist for 1 minute. While the winds last, the area is difficult terrain for creatures both in the air and on the ground. Creatures that end their turn inside the wind take 1d6 persistent piercing damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage from the initial blast increases by 2d6 and the persistent piercing damage for creatures ending their turn inside the wind increases by 1.

You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

You create enough food to feed six Medium creatures for a day. This food is bland and unappealing, but it is nourishing. After 1 day, if no one has eaten the food, it decays and becomes inedible. Most Small creatures eat one-quarter as much as a Medium creature (one-sixteenth as much for most Tiny creatures), and most Large creatures eat 10 times as much (100 times as much for Huge creatures and so on).

Heightened (4th) You can feed 12 Medium creatures.

Heightened (6th) You can feed 50 Medium creatures.

Heightened (8th) You can feed 200 Medium creatures.

Plants and fungi burst out or quickly grow, entangling creatures. All surfaces in the area are difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} to remove these effects.

30 feet. Plants in the aura sprout and flourish. The area is difficult terrain for all creatures that are not vitatella. Each square of difficult terrain can be removed by spells or abilities that deal fire damage to an area. The vitatella can use a single concentrate action to regrow all destroyed plants.

The vitatella causes large flowers to sprout and release pollen. The pollen floats in the vitatella's growth aura for 1 round. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it; the vitatella can see clearly through their own pollen. Each creature that enters the area or that starts its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save.
